title: RelaySuite / green components, broken product
subtitle: Cross-repository acceptance requires a consistent composition and a real consumer journey.
purpose: Deliver a job from producer to consumer with correct deadlines and explicit failures.
boundary: Pinned producer → queue → worker → consumer composition; four fictional components.
beneficiary: Agents submitting jobs and consuming the final result.
intent_status: Accepted for a bounded experiment within the fictional scenario; not an actual portfolio commitment.
genesis_rationale: This fictional repository was created by agents to isolate a consumer-facing capability. Its boundary is a hypothesis, not proof that a separate repository is necessary.
alternatives: Merge tightly coupled components into one repository
authority: Illustrative delegated mandate only. No actual device, repository, deployment, financial, or lifecycle authority is granted by this example.
non_goals: Wait for a central registry to become operational

semantic_reviews.topic: Does this assignment serve the parent outcome?
semantic_reviews.assessment: Judge the named consumer outcome rather than the existence of infrastructure or the size of the repository.
semantic_reviews.support: The fictional scenario names a bounded consumer and a failure that would prevent its outcome.
semantic_reviews.countercase: The same outcome may be served more cheaply by an existing owner, a smaller feature, or no new product.
semantic_reviews.discriminator: Execute the smallest real consumer journey under the same success and failure conditions.
semantic_reviews.confidence_basis: Reasoned interpretation of the supplied fictional premises; no empirical product confidence is claimed.

next_action: Repair the contract boundary under one integration owner, then re-run actual serialization and supported version-skew paths.
stop_condition: Pause new component splitting until a passing integrated baseline and a coherent boundary justification exist.

restart_packet.accepted_baseline: Use this fixture as an example only; establish a real pinned subject and assignment before operational work.
failed_hypotheses: A well-formed record is not proof the product behavior occurred.
restart_packet.next_reproduction: Translate the scenario into a bounded authorized real-product experiment, then replace fictional premises with collected observations.
restart_packet.budget_and_permissions: No product mutation or external actions authorized by this package. Carry forward the actual cumulative budget and permissions from the operating mandate.

lineage.description: A constructed teaching case, not a measurement of changes in the user portfolio.

provenance_notice: Fictional worked example. Every purported product outcome below is an authored premise. Result records remain PROPOSED and instrument qualifications are absent, so the real evidence reducer grants no acceptance credit.
